// Kick Auto Chat - Content Script
let timerId = null;
let targetSelector = null;
let isRunning = false;
let currentIndex = 0;
let lastSentMessage = "";
let toggleDuplicateMarker = false;

chrome.runtime.onMessage.addListener((request, sender, sendResponse) => {
  if (request.action === "PING") {
    sendResponse({ status: "alive" });
    return true;
  }

  if (request.action === "GET_STATUS") {
    sendResponse({
      isRunning: isRunning,
      hasTarget: !!getTargetElement(),
      targetSelector: targetSelector
    });
    return true;
  }

  if (request.action === "SELECT_TARGET") {
    selectTargetMode();
    sendResponse({ status: "SELECTING" });
    return true;
  }

  if (request.action === "RESET_TARGET") {
    targetSelector = null;
    stopBot();
    sendResponse({ status: "RESET_COMPLETE" });
    return true;
  }

  if (request.action === "START") {
    const el = getTargetElement();
    if (!el) {
      sendResponse({ status: "NO_TARGET" });
      return true;
    }
    startBot(request.settings);
    sendResponse({ status: "STARTED" });
    return true;
  }

  if (request.action === "STOP") {
    stopBot();
    sendResponse({ status: "STOPPED" });
    return true;
  }

  if (request.action === "CHECK_TARGET") {
    sendResponse({ hasTarget: !!getTargetElement() });
    return true;
  }
});

function getTargetElement() {
  if (!targetSelector) return null;

  try {
    const el = document.querySelector(targetSelector);
    return el && isElementVisible(el) ? el : null;
  } catch (_) {
    targetSelector = null;
    return null;
  }
}

function isElementVisible(el) {
  if (!el) return false;
  const style = window.getComputedStyle(el);
  return style.display !== 'none' && style.visibility !== 'hidden' && style.opacity !== '0';
}

function getUniqueSelector(el) {
  if (!el) return null;
  if (el.id) return '#' + el.id;
  if (el.getAttribute('data-testid')) return `[data-testid="${el.getAttribute('data-testid')}"]`;
  if (el.getAttribute('data-chat-input')) return '[data-chat-input="true"]';
  if (el.getAttribute('placeholder')) return `[placeholder="${el.getAttribute('placeholder')}"]`;

  let path = [];
  let current = el;
  while (current && current.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE) {
    let selector = current.nodeName.toLowerCase();
    if (selector === 'body' || selector === 'html') {
      path.unshift(selector);
      break;
    }
    if (current.id) {
      selector += '#' + current.id;
      path.unshift(selector);
      break;
    } else {
      let sib = current, nth = 1;
      while (sib = sib.previousElementSibling) {
        if (sib.nodeName.toLowerCase() === selector) nth++;
      }
      if (nth !== 1) selector += ":nth-of-type(" + nth + ")";
    }
    path.unshift(selector);
    current = current.parentNode;
  }
  return path.join(" > ");
}

function selectTargetMode() {
  showOverlay("CLICK ON THE KICK CHAT INPUT BOX");

  const clickHandler = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();

    if (!(e.target instanceof Element)) return;

    const targetEl = e.target.closest('input, textarea, [contenteditable="true"], [role="textbox"]');
    if (!targetEl) {
      showOverlay("PLEASE CLICK ON A CHAT INPUT BOX");
      return;
    }

    targetSelector = getUniqueSelector(targetEl);
    stopBot();

    targetEl.style.outline = "3px solid #53FC18";
    targetEl.style.boxShadow = "0 0 15px rgba(83, 252, 24, 0.6)";
    setTimeout(() => {
      targetEl.style.outline = "";
      targetEl.style.boxShadow = "";
    }, 1200);

    removeOverlay();
    document.removeEventListener('click', clickHandler, true);

    try {
      chrome.runtime.sendMessage({ action: "TARGET_SET_SUCCESS" });
    } catch (_) {}
  };

  document.addEventListener('click', clickHandler, true);
}

function stopBot() {
  isRunning = false;
  if (timerId) {
    clearTimeout(timerId);
    timerId = null;
  }
}

function startBot(settings) {
  stopBot();
  isRunning = true;
  currentIndex = 0;

  const { mode, presetMessages, singleMessage, emoji, minInterval, maxInterval, isSequential, antiDuplicate } = settings || {};
  const messageList = presetMessages ? presetMessages.split(/\r?\n/).map(m => m.trim()).filter(m => m.length > 0) : [];

  const loop = () => {
    if (!isRunning) return;

    const currentInput = getTargetElement();
    if (currentInput) {
      let msgToSend = "";

      if (mode === 'single') {
        msgToSend = (singleMessage || "").trim();
      } else if (mode === 'emoji') {
        msgToSend = (emoji || "").trim();
      } else {
        // List Mode
        if (messageList.length > 0) {
          if (isSequential) {
            msgToSend = messageList[currentIndex];
            currentIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % messageList.length;
          } else {
            msgToSend = messageList[Math.floor(Math.random() * messageList.length)];
          }
        }
      }

      if (msgToSend) {
        // Anti-Duplicate Bypass (Kick rejects identical consecutive messages)
        if (antiDuplicate !== false && msgToSend === lastSentMessage) {
          toggleDuplicateMarker = !toggleDuplicateMarker;
          msgToSend += toggleDuplicateMarker ? '\u200B' : ' ';
        }
        lastSentMessage = msgToSend;
        sendMessageToElement(currentInput, msgToSend);
      }
    }

    const min = Math.max(1, parseInt(minInterval) || 30);
    const max = Math.max(min, parseInt(maxInterval) || 60);
    const nextDelay = Math.floor(Math.random() * (max - min + 1) + min) * 1000;

    timerId = setTimeout(loop, nextDelay);
  };

  // Initial immediate or short-delayed execution
  timerId = setTimeout(loop, 500);
}

function sendMessageToElement(inputEl, text) {
  try {
    inputEl.focus();

    const isContentEditable = inputEl.getAttribute('contenteditable') === 'true' || inputEl.isContentEditable;

    if (isContentEditable) {
      // Modern Lexical / React contenteditable support
      inputEl.focus();

      // Select all existing text and replace
      const selection = window.getSelection();
      const range = document.createRange();
      range.selectNodeContents(inputEl);
      selection.removeAllRanges();
      selection.addRange(range);

      // execCommand already emits the input events Lexical/React needs. Dispatching
      // beforeinput separately makes some Kick editor versions insert text twice.
      let inserted = false;
      try {
        inserted = document.execCommand('insertText', false, text);
      } catch (_) {}

      if (!inserted) {
        inputEl.textContent = text;
        inputEl.dispatchEvent(new InputEvent('input', {
          bubbles: true,
          inputType: 'insertText',
          data: text
        }));
      }
    } else {
      // Standard Input / Textarea
      const nativeInputValueSetter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, "value")?.set;
      const nativeTextAreaValueSetter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype, "value")?.set;

      if (inputEl.tagName === 'INPUT' && nativeInputValueSetter) {
        nativeInputValueSetter.call(inputEl, text);
      } else if (inputEl.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' && nativeTextAreaValueSetter) {
        nativeTextAreaValueSetter.call(inputEl, text);
      } else {
        inputEl.value = text;
      }

      inputEl.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
      inputEl.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
    }

    // Trigger exactly one send action. Enter plus a button click can submit twice.
    setTimeout(() => {
      const container = inputEl.closest('form') || inputEl.closest('div[class*="chat"]') || inputEl.parentElement?.parentElement || document;
      const sendBtn = container.querySelector(
        'button[type="submit"], button[aria-label="Send"], button[aria-label="Send message"], button[aria-label="Chat"], button:has(svg[data-icon="paper-plane"]), button[data-chat-send="true"]'
      ) || Array.from(container.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent?.trim().toLowerCase() === 'chat');

      if (sendBtn && !sendBtn.disabled) {
        sendBtn.click();
        return;
      }

      const enterDown = new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, key: 'Enter', code: 'Enter', keyCode: 13, which: 13 });
      const enterUp = new KeyboardEvent('keyup', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, key: 'Enter', code: 'Enter', keyCode: 13, which: 13 });
      inputEl.dispatchEvent(enterDown);
      inputEl.dispatchEvent(enterUp);
    }, 150);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("[Kick Auto Chat] Send error:", err);
  }
}

function showOverlay(text) {
  removeOverlay();
  const overlay = document.createElement('div');
  overlay.id = 'kick-bot-overlay';
  overlay.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;top:20px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:#0b0e11;color:#53FC18;padding:12px 24px;border:2px solid #53FC18;border-radius:8px;z-index:999999;font-weight:700;font-family:sans-serif;pointer-events:none;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.9);letter-spacing:0.5px;';
  overlay.innerText = text;
  document.body.appendChild(overlay);
}

function removeOverlay() {
  const overlay = document.getElementById('kick-bot-overlay');
  if (overlay) overlay.remove();
}
